destekKurallari.aciklama: When a new request is opened (panel, web, email), rules are tried from top to bottom; the actions of matching rules are applied.
destekKurallari.kosulYok: With no conditions, the rule runs on every request.
destekKurallari.durdurAciklama: If this rule matches, later rules are not tried.
destekKurallari.hazirCevapNotu: The automatic reply is sent at most once per request and never to an unrecognized email sender.

dene.aciklama: See which rules a sample request would match. Nothing is saved.
dene.durduruldu: Later rules were not tried because of “stop” in the last rule.

hata.genel: The action could not be completed. Please try again.
hata.gecersiz_kosul: One of the conditions is invalid.
hata.kosul_degeri_bos: A condition value cannot be empty.
hata.gecersiz_eylem: One of the actions is invalid.
hata.ekipte_yok: The person to assign is not on the team list.
hata.hazir_cevap_yok: The selected canned reply was not found.
hata.kural_siniri: The rule limit has been reached.
hata.liste_degisti: The list changed elsewhere; it has been reloaded.
hata.oturum_gerekli: Your session has ended; please sign in again.

eposta.aciklama: Emails sent to your support address automatically become requests; clients can continue the conversation by replying to notifications.
eposta.gelenAdresIpucu: Used as “Reply-To” on outgoing replies and shown to clients as a hint.
eposta.sinirlar: Limits: {{saatlik}} messages per sender per hour, {{mb}} MB per attachment, {{adet}} attachments per message.
eposta.kurulumNotu: Step-by-step setup: DESTEK-EPOSTA-KURULUM.md in the repository root. Key values are never shown here.

nedenler.yeni_talep_yetkisiz_belirtec: New request (tried to write to someone else's request)
